description: You're watching a broadcast and a step seems to show a secret (a key, token, password) or someone's personal information: report it. It's hidden from everyone at once, and the broadcaster decides whether to put it back. Never repeat the secret anywhere.

key.description: For a private broadcast, its watch key

step.description: The step number (1 is the first)

name: report_step
title: Report a step that shows a secret
